project.name: Rameldry Mill Bank
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 6 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. The locality is not split into “Rameldry” and “Mill Bank”. Nearby parish heritage and services are not transferred.
